HistoryProduction.title: HistoryProduction
HistoryProduction.description: A generated historical video storyboard or standalone SVG production created with Gemini and persisted per user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID who owns this production.

title.description: Title of the historical video or SVG artwork.

prompt.description: Original user prompt used to generate the historical scenes.

generationType.description: Whether this production is a multi-scene animated video storyboard or a single SVG artwork.

backgroundTheme.description: Canvas background theme the SVG scenes were designed for.

aspectRatio.description: Viewport aspect ratio of the generated video/SVG canvas.

totalDurationSeconds.description: Total duration of all scenes in seconds.

scenes.description: Ordered list of 1 to 8 animated SVG scenes.

favorite.description: Whether the user bookmarked this production.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/histories/{historyId}.description: User-owned collection of generated historical video storyboards and SVG scenes.
